About the job

Join our client’s innovative and fast-growing team in Malta as a Junior Frontend Software Developer! 




As a Junior Frontend Software Developer, you will develop modern, user-friendly web applications using Vue.js. You will build reusable components and libraries for future use and optimize applications for speed, scalability, and responsiveness. Furthermore, you will collaborate with designers, developers, and stakeholders to ensure high-quality user experiences and visual consistency.




In order to be successful in this role, hands-on experience or interest is essential in programming languages including: React, TypeScript , and HTML.




Fresh graduates are welcome to apply! Our client remains committed to mentoring and supporting new hires, offering excellent learning opportunities, health insurance, and an end-of-year performance bonus.




If you're excited about frontend development and want to be part of a dynamic tech company, apply now: ella.micallef@reed.com / +356 27794561
